leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function to search for a target value in a 2D matrix
Apply binary search principles to efficiently navigate sorted rows and columns
Construct logic to convert 2D matrix indices into a flattened 1D representation
Manipulate row and column pointers to traverse the matrix during search
Initialize and update search boundaries based on comparison results
Configure the search algorithm to handle edge cases like empty matrices
Integrate comparison operations to determine search direction at each step
